articles.summary: Cayetano Gea-Carrasco brings extensive AI, data, and analytics experience Wells Fargo Company (NYSE: WFC) today announced that Cayetano Gea-Carrasco is joining the company as head of AI and Data for Consumer Banking and Lending. He will report to Saul Van Beurden, head of Enterprise AI and co-CEO of Consumer Banking and Lending and will be based in San Francisco. Cayetano Gea-Carrasco will join Wells Fargo as the head of AI and Data for Consumer Banking and Lending. Gea-Carrasco will oversee the full lifecycle of AI use cases, simplify the data environment, and accelerate responsible delivery of AI for Consumer Banking and Lending. He also will partner with the Enterprise AI team to scale solutions across the company. “Customers do not think about channels.
